jointCoverage.description: Euclidean distance to the nearest development input row after development-fitted standardization. No safety or feasibility cutoff is applied.

methods.distributions: 32 common equal-width bins per variable across all years; count and within-period percentages.
methods.outliers: Values below Q1 - 1.5 IQR or above Q3 + 1.5 IQR within the selected period. Flags only; no rows removed.
methods.correlations: Pearson linear correlation and Spearman rank correlation; select development, comparison or all observations.
methods.vif: Ordinary least-squares regression of each standardized development input on the seven other inputs plus an intercept; VIF = 1/(1-R2). Diagnostic only, no feature removal.
methods.shift: KS and standardized mean change compare 2011-2014 with 2015. Mean change is divided by development population standard deviation.
methods.residuals: Observed minus predicted. Positive means underprediction; negative means overprediction. Summaries use all 7,384 saved comparison predictions.
methods.errorBins: Five equal-frequency groups from 2015 actual target or input values. Used for retrospective diagnosis, not fitting or target leakage.
methods.sampling: Scatter: every 40th combined data row; prediction/residual plots: every 10th comparison row; sequence: approximately 180 equally spaced rows per year. All summary statistics use full data.
